title: ICSSG-AI 2027 Official Website Launched
content: We are delighted to announce the launch of the official website for the International Conference on Smart Systems and Sustainable Governance Powered by AI (ICSSG-AI 2027). Stay tuned for updates on paper submission, speakers, and registration.

title: Call for Papers Now Open
content: We invite researchers, academicians, and industry professionals to submit original research papers across all six conference tracks. The submission deadline is September 15, 2026.

title: Keynote Speakers Announced
content: We are honored to announce our distinguished keynote speakers from IIT Delhi, MIT Media Lab, ETH Zurich, University of Tokyo, and Infosys. Visit the Speakers section for details.

title: Workshop Proposals Invited
content: Proposals for workshops, tutorials, and special sessions are now being accepted. Submit your proposal by September 30, 2026.

title: Early Bird Registration Opens
content: Take advantage of discounted early bird registration rates. Register before December 15, 2026 to avail special pricing.
